about: compiler/native: Stop 0 lowering from checked compiler/ir into nativeobj/EIR v1. Each row breaks one soundness, ABI, or refusal contract and is killed by compiler/native's laws and archive verification test.

mutants.name: native-multi-file-accepted
mutants.rule: FromIR refuses multi-file packages cleanly with nativeobj.Refused.

mutants.name: native-unit-call-gets-dst
mutants.rule: Calls to unit (0-result) functions emit zero destination slots so nativeobj.Check and ABIInternal match the callee signature.

mutants.name: native-unit-call-as-value
mutants.rule: Using a unit function in a value expression is refused with nativeobj.Refused instead of failing later as Malformed.

mutants.name: native-range-continue-skips-step
mutants.rule: A continue inside a range loop jumps to the increment step before rechecking the loop bound.

mutants.name: native-init-not-refused
mutants.rule: Package init functions are refused explicitly instead of failing nativeobj.Check as Malformed.

mutants.name: native-foreign-call-accepted
mutants.rule: Calls to unknown or foreign functions fail closed with nativeobj.Refused.
